item.title: Backblaze has stopped backing up your data
item.description:
📝 Backblaze has quietly stopped backing up your data TLDR: Despite claiming to backup all your data, Backblaze quietly stopped backing up OneDrive and Dropbox folders - along with potentially many other things. A disturbing trend Backup software is meant to back up your files. No problem I thought, I’ll just restore this from Backblaze.
🔗 Read more: https://rareese.com/posts/backblaze/

item.title: MOS tech 6502 8-bit microprocessor in pure SQL powered by Postgres
item.description:
